pullRequests.body:
Functional C for USA v1.01's remaining assembly, for the native port in OpenRAC. This is the running branch: backfill keeps landing here in batches as the gate proves it, so it stays a draft for now.
No matches here, 0 functions added to the report. progress/, the README table and docs/VERSIONS.md are untouched. Nothing in nonmatching/functional/ is compiled into the matching build.
What's in it

357 rows in nonmatching/functional.tsv, up from 29. 12 are per-level copies, each SAME on its own…
